summary: All three prior findings are resolved in the frozen corrected candidate. Static inspection found no concrete regression in the reviewed fixes. The sentinel matcher rejects suffixed test names, package preservation compares a bounded fixture inventory, and helper validation checks exact integer IDs, initialization metadata/capabilities and object input schemas. Focused regression cases cover the reported failures.

E3: /Users/merdankiji/localGit/disk_steward/docs/reliability/evidence/TASK-571/reviewed-source/test_verify_packaged_candidate.py:151-162 adds inventory regressions for a SQLite sidecar, an additional export and a new directory.

E4: /Users/merdankiji/localGit/disk_steward/docs/reliability/evidence/TASK-571/reviewed-source/verify_packaged_candidate.py:91-125 rejects boolean IDs, non-object results, incomplete initialization metadata/capabilities and missing or malformed object input schemas. E5: /Users/merdankiji/localGit/disk_steward/docs/reliability/evidence/TASK-571/reviewed-source/test_verify_packaged_candidate.py:127-149 covers missing initialization fields, boolean IDs, absent server version and malformed input schemas.
